versions.changelog: Adds liq-feed, cross-venue liquidation pressure in 5-second buckets with a gap-free cursor ($0.001 a call), and the $25 30-day bot pass that works only on it. 83 paid data routes, 7 free routes, 7 prepaid key routes.

Networks updated for the 14 Oct 2026 service. Nine networks are in every 402 and paid in USDC: Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Arc, Algorand, Optimism, Monad and Avalanche. Eleven more are offered on request with GET /api/<route>|<network> (the CAIP-2 id): Celo, HyperEVM, Unichain, Scroll, SKALE Base (USDC.e), BNB Chain (AUSD), Ethereum, Robinhood Chain (USDG), World Chain, and Sei and X Layer on routes priced $0.005 or more. 20 x402 networks plus MPP on Tempo make 21 chains. The skill now says the per-call token is not always USDC, which payTo address belongs to which network (read from the live manifest), and that GET /api/keys/balance is free next to the prepaid keys. Our three proof payments (Optimism, Monad, Avalanche) are linked. Unchanged: 82 paid data routes at $0.001-$0.10 with the route tables read from the live openapi, the half-price batch-settlement and Circle Gateway options, MPP, prepaid API keys, the 451 note on the language tasks.

Rebuilt for the 14 Oct 2026 catalogue: 82 paid data routes (was 60), with the route tables generated from the live openapi so counts, prices and parameters match it. New: the signal board and per-coin signal, Solana pre-trade checks (token check, token flow, holder clusters), sanctions screening, scholarly papers, Wikipedia, email and domain checks, utilities (hash, QR, time, convert) and seven fixed-purpose language tasks (OCR, summarize, extract, translate, classify, prompt-injection check, transcribe), which answer 451 where the model API behind them is not offered. Adds prepaid API keys for bots that cannot pay x402 (X-AgentFeed-Key header, half price per call). A failed or stale source is a 503 and an unsupported symbol a 400, neither billed. Rails: Algorand, plus the half-price batch-settlement and Circle Gateway options with their payTo addresses.
Adds the Arc rail (eip155:5042, its own payTo), the Hyperliquid whales route, and notes that x402 v1 X-PAYMENT works on Solana and Base.
Adds Deribit options summary and dealer GEX, a one-call market-state regime read, and the TradFi perps funding radar; 59 paid routes.
Initial release: liquidation tape, heatmap, cascade forecast, funding radar
